blocked_action: Replace Codecov CLI artifact acquisition through cli.codecov.io only if maintainer accepts this verified PyPI provenance route.
decision: This route cryptographically ties the exact PyPI wheel digest to Codecov’s tagged GitHub Actions Trusted Publisher. Codecov Action use_pypi explicitly bypasses its GPG check, so CI would need a pinned, pre-execution PEP 740 verification of the same wheel and then execute that verified artifact; a simple use_pypi toggle is insufficient.
remaining: Maintainer decision on replacing Codecov GPG artifact verification with verified PyPI Sigstore provenance, or wait for cli.codecov.io recovery.

verification.platform: Sigstore certificate and Rekor transparency proof cryptographically verified by pypi-attestations
